data.body: E1 (f161) plan-review reached PASS/signed on round 4, then was revised once more to honour this epic's own recorded design decision: the provenance contract now carries a FOURTH required field, instrument=<live-call|simulation|static-analysis>, alongside environment/principal/privilege_posture. Rationale (surfaced by the G7 criterion, verified against this epic's COMMENT event): privilege_posture cannot distinguish a simulator from a live call - both can honestly declare production-equivalent - so escape 2b (simulate-principal-policy returning a confident WRONG authorization conclusion that only a real from-instance call refuted) would have stayed invisible in the record. This epic has exactly one child, so no sibling could deliver it. Also added a deterministic trigger to the AGENT-tier criterion so an ~85x-cost criterion routes only on plans carrying [operator-attested], not on every plan.
